answer:
The plenary speaker from CSIRO at the 25th International Modelling Congress (MODSIM2023) was **Dr. Simon Barry**. 

He delivered a plenary presentation titled "Modelling and the rise of Machine Learning" during the congress held in Darwin, Australia. Dr. Barry was formerly the Digital Lead for the Environment business unit at CSIRO and passed away in 2023.
